issues.reason: A prepared statement is a medium, not a place: the oblique is decided by the question the PP answers, and the framing-PP rule ('in fluid mechanics' -> (In …)) routes it to the preposition actually used, so (Location sk_say_1 sk_statement_1) asserts a spatial containment the sentence does not state.

The specificational copula 'X's preference is to V' is uncovered (the reviewer's own gap), and (For <noun-symbol> <argument>) is the instruction set's own shape for a noun's clausal argument ('a vehicle for V-ing', 'the search for the heir'), so the atom is true of the content and well-typed; the preposition-actually-used rule bars swapping a synonym head for a STATED preposition, and removing the link instead would leave the sealed achieve event dangling.

'Mirant CEO' is a titular premodifier, not the comma-set appositive the wrapper rule is stated for, and Names and casing prescribes the kind in 'one ordinary type atom' whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it — a bare, tenseless (Member marce_fuller ceo) is true and well-typed, so the missing Past wrapper is an unsettled standard rather than a false atom.

The sealing rule projects exactly the definite referent's Member/Name typing atom and keeps everything else inside ('the event class and every role atom always stay inside'), so a top-level (Possession sk_pref_1 mirant) asserts outside a non-factive 'say' a relation the text supplies only within the quoted claim.

gaps_confirmed: a copular clause whose predicate is a to-infinitive ('Our strong preference is to achieve X') — neither the categorical section nor the control pattern covers a specificational copula
direct/verbatim quotation as a speech verb's complement — the attitudes section is written for a finite that-clause and says nothing about quotation marks or quoted deixis
a sub-day qualifier outside the listed day-parts ('early Friday') — extended here as a bare 'early' symbol on Time
new_gaps: whether a titular premodifier ('Mirant CEO Marce Fuller', 'President Ronald Reagan') takes the host clause's tense wrapper the way a comma-set appositive does

quoted first-person possessives ('our') inside a sealed quotation — nothing says whether the possessor resolves to the speaker's organization or to a group witness, nor which side of the seal the possessive belongs on
repair_summary: Replaced (Location sk_say_1 sk_statement_1) with the preposition-named oblique (In sk_say_1 sk_statement_1); moved (Possession sk_pref_1 mirant) from top level into the sealed (And …) under Theme, leaving only the definite NP's typing atom projected.
notes: The OutOf multi-word preposition, the unfused adjectival 'prepared', the (Weekday friday) term and the non-factive seal are all as the instruction set prescribes.
